Write me a 3 paragraph story about a tiger who learns to cook biryani
11:42 AM

Sheru the tiger was tired of plain jungle food. One evening, a warm smell of spices drifted in from a village wedding, and he followed it to a huge pot of biryani. He hid behind a banyan tree, watched the old cook Rahim Chacha at work, and decided he would learn to make it himself.

His first try was a disaster. He burnt the rice, dropped in a whole fistful of chillies, and sneezed so hard that the monkeys fell out of their tree laughing. Sheru went back night after night, though, and learned the secrets one by one: soak the rice, brown the onions slowly, layer everything with saffron and mint, then seal the pot and wait.

That waiting was the hardest part for a tiger, but Sheru managed it. When he finally lifted the lid, the smell brought the whole jungle running, deer and monkeys included. Nobody was afraid of him that night, and from then on every full moon was biryani night at Sheru's den.

11:43 AM

Here are 5 tips to sleep better:

Go to bed and wake up at the same time every day, weekends included.
Put your phone away 30 minutes before bed.
Skip tea and coffee after 4:00 PM.
Keep your room dark, cool and quiet.
Eat a light dinner at least 2 hours before you sleep.
